title: Fix 1: Reconnect Sat/Sun routes to match hotel bookings
body:
## Summary

Fixes inconsistency #1 in the itinerary: the Saturday-night accommodation (**AAA Granary, 575 Staverton Road, Promised Land** — near Sheffield) did not connect logically to the Sunday plan, which incorrectly started at Cradle Mountain. Hotel bookings were treated as the source of truth and the routes/schedule were reconnected around them.

## Changes

- **Saturday** — added the missing **Route/Points** block (Deloraine → Mole Creek → Cradle Mountain → 575 Staverton Road, Promised Land) and corrected the drive-to-accommodation time to 16:40–17:30 (Cradle Mountain → Promised Land is ~45 min).
- **Friday** — trimmed the route/points to end at Deloraine (the Mole Creek / Sheffield / Cradle Mountain leg belonged to Saturday).
- **Sunday** — reflowed the morning to start from Promised Land, inserting the previously-missing Promised Land → Cradle Mountain drive before the Enchanted Walk, and prepended the accommodation to the Sunday Route/Points.
- **Bad-weather Sunday** — now also starts with the drive from Promised Land.
- **Trip Summary** — Saturday sleep corrected from "Cradle Mountain" to "Promised Land (near Sheffield)".

## Note

Sunday still keeps the Enchanted Walk, which involves a ~40-min drive each way back to Cradle Mountain before the airport. Timing works but is tight; the backtrack can be dropped for a more relaxed final morning if preferred.
